sources.instrument: GINAN self-calibrating radiometer and SKALA4.1 antenna on 40-m ground mesh at CSIRO Murchison Observatory
sources.measured_product: Calibrated antenna temperature in K versus frequency and LST, with RFI mask and frequency-dependent antenna beam patterns; not a sky map or pointwise brightness by itself
sources.observation: 2024-10-23, approximately LST 20:00-04:00, southern sky; approximately 51% of celestial sphere has relative response >0.1
sources.data_release_status: verified public machine-readable release, no small primary spectrum downloaded in bounded pass

paper_model_correction.provenance: Published equations 1-2; derived model corrections, not independent per-frequency observations
paper_model_correction.uncertainty: At 150 MHz: measurement rms 1.22%, corrected GSM2016 rms 1.81%; absolute measurement uncertainty <2% across 60-150 MHz, rising to <8% at 350 MHz (paper text).

sources.lowsky_relevance: external absolute-calibration stress test above nominal 1-50 MHz range only; do not extrapolate published correction below 60 MHz

sources.paper: Monsalve et al., Absolute Calibration of Diffuse Radio Surveys at 45 and 150 MHz, ApJ (2021)
sources.instrument: EDGES total-power Low/Mid/High Band radiometers; wide beam, LST drift scans at latitude -26.7 deg
sources.product_type: Fitted scale and zero-level corrections to existing maps, not public per-channel antenna spectrum in this source
sources.lowsky_relevance: 45-MHz corrected map scale is directly in range; compare beam-convolved total brightness/zero level only after checking input-map lineage. A map correction is not 45-MHz independent pixel data.

sources.product_type: Reduced EDGES low-band Figure 1 sky-averaged antenna spectrum, Tsky in K plus fitted foreground/21-cm residual curves
sources.observation: low-1 configuration H2, 2016 day 252 through 2017 day 94; beam-averaged southern sky
sources.caveat: Use Tsky and Weight columns as released, not fitted Tmodel/T21 as diffuse-sky measurements. Global-signal extraction is model-dependent and contested. Entire dataset is >=50 MHz, so no direct 1-50 MHz validation.

sources.instrument: LEDA radiometers at OVRO-LWA, northern sky
sources.published_summary: Combined beta -2.50 to -2.56 over LST 9-12.5 h, scatter/error 0.09-0.12
sources.data_status: No public machine-readable spectra identified; paper says underlying data shared on reasonable request, which was not made
sources.calibration_lineage: Absolute temperature scale explicitly corrected to match extrapolation of Guzman 45-MHz map; not independent absolute zero-level holdout
sources.lowsky_relevance: independent slope/beam comparison above 50 MHz, conditional on map-tied absolute scale

sources.published_summary: Absolute brightness systematic 1.2%; 150-MHz map recommended scale approximately 1.05 and offset subtraction 21.4 K; spectral index -2.3 to -2.45 over observed LST 23-01 h
sources.data_status: Paper summaries only; no numerical spectrum acquired in bounded pass

sources.classification: Secondary workshop report, not a standalone EDGES measurement or numerical data release
sources.action: Do not count as an observational anchor; follow cited primary experiments instead.
